application_rule: The assertion IDs, scenarios, selectors, expected observations, points, source hashes, and adapter policy are frozen semantic contracts. Existing commands/command_specs record construction and historical-ground-truth invocations only; they are not authorized controlled-run physical commands because several execute candidate Cargo machinery beside oracle source. Before any controlled run, a separate immutable production command manifest must map every machine assertion to candidate-only artifact build, isolated trusted probe build, and expectation-free execution stages, pass confidentiality/mutation controls, and preserve these semantic contracts unchanged. A naming/type-only adapter is allowed only where selector.adapter_allowed=true and must be blinded, hashed, and reviewed; it may not implement behavior.
